_comment: Worked example of a doc-verify sequence-sweep config. Copy it and replace the vocabularies for your own statement class. 'subject' and 'relation' are lists of regex alternatives; a sentence is a candidate when it matches at least one of each. 'known_members' is the positive control: each phrase must appear in some candidate, or the sweep FAILs on the grounds that its vocabulary has a hole. The example below is the guard-coverage stage-order class it was built for.
label: stage sequence
subject: \bstage\s*\d+[a-z]?\b
\bgate\b
certification sweep

known_members.phrase: must not start until 4a has landed
Re-run stage 13 immediately before this stage
This stage edits the same script
known_members.note: Stage 9's interaction note. The member the first vocabulary missed: it states its relationship with 'when this stage runs' and uses no ordering word, which is why 'when' is in the relation list.
